comment:
* Compatibility library for NotificationManager with fallbacks for older platforms. * *

To use this class, call the static function {@link #from} to get a * {@link NotificationManagerCompat} object, and then call one of its * methods to post or cancel notifications.

variables.name: EXTRA_USE_SIDE_CHANNEL
variables.comment:
* Notification extras key: if set to true, the posted notification should use
     * the side channel for delivery instead of using notification manager.

variables.name: ACTION_BIND_SIDE_CHANNEL
variables.comment:
* Intent action to register for on a service to receive side channel
     * notifications. The listening service must be in the same package as an enabled
     * {@link android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService}.

variables.name: MAX_SIDE_CHANNEL_SDK_VERSION
variables.comment:
* Maximum sdk build version which needs support for side channeled notifications.
     * Currently the only needed use is for side channeling group children before KITKAT_WATCH.

variables.name: SIDE_CHANNEL_RETRY_BASE_INTERVAL_MS
variables.comment: Base time delay for a side channel listener queue retry.

variables.name: SIDE_CHANNEL_RETRY_MAX_COUNT
variables.comment: Maximum retries for a side channel listener before dropping tasks.

variables.name: sEnabledNotificationListenersLock
variables.comment: Cache of enabled notification listener components

methods.name: public static NotificationManagerCompat from(Context context)
methods.comment: Get a {@link NotificationManagerCompat} instance for a provided context.

methods.name: public void cancel(int id)
methods.comment:
* Cancel a previously shown notification.
     * @param id the ID of the notification

methods.name: public void cancel(String tag, int id)
methods.comment:
* Cancel a previously shown notification.
     * @param tag the string identifier of the notification.
     * @param id the ID of the notification

methods.name: public void notify(int id, Notification notification)
methods.comment:
* Post a notification to be shown in the status bar, stream, etc.
     * @param id the ID of the notification
     * @param notification the notification to post to the system

methods.name: public void notify(String tag, int id, Notification notification)
methods.comment:
* Post a notification to be shown in the status bar, stream, etc.
     * @param tag the string identifier for a notification. Can be {@code null}.
     * @param id the ID of the notification. The pair (tag, id) must be unique within your app.
     * @param notification the notification to post to the system

methods.name: public static Set<String> getEnabledListenerPackages(Context context)
methods.comment: * Get the set of packages that have an enabled notification listener component within them.

methods.name: private static boolean useSideChannelForNotification(Notification notification)
methods.comment: * Returns true if this notification should use the side channel for delivery.

methods.name: private void pushSideChannelQueue(Task task)
methods.comment: * Push a notification task for distribution to notification side channels.
